fields.label: Country
fields.note: The select posts numeric geoname IDs, not the labels (e.g. India=1269750, United States=6252001).

fields.label: State / Region
fields.note: Composite 'countryId-stateId' IDs (e.g. California=6252001-5332921); labels shown by the select.

notes: The search page is a GET form action=/search-jobs with k (keyword), Country, State and hidden orgIds. k=engineer reduced the advertised total from 317 to 219, confirming the keyword parameter. Country/State submit numeric geoname IDs from their selects. The page also has a sort dropdown (Relevancy 0, Date Updated 2, Job Title 3, Location 4, Distance 6) but it is applied by the /search-jobs/results AJAX (sortCriteria/sortDirection), not by the listing URL, so no URL sort is declared here.
evidence: https://careers.netapp.com/search-jobs (form action=/search-jobs, input name=k, selects name=Country and name=State)
https://careers.netapp.com/search-jobs (Country/State option values; sort select data-search-results-sort-criteria 0/2/3/4/6)
